googleCalendar.connectHint: Copy your ImpactOS tasks and appointments into a dedicated "Future Studio" calendar in your Google account. Your personal events are never read.
googleCalendar.notConfiguredHint: Google Calendar is not configured on this server yet (GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, GOOGLE_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY).
googleCalendar.revokedHint: Access to Google Calendar was withdrawn. Reconnect to resume the sync.
googleCalendar.syncFailed: The Google Calendar sync failed. Try again in a moment.
googleCalendar.disconnectHint: Access is revoked and the stored tokens are deleted. The "Future Studio" calendar stays in your Google account; you can delete it there.

outcome.connected: Google Calendar connected. Your tasks and appointments are now in the "Future Studio" calendar of your Google account.
outcome.connectedSyncPending: Google Calendar connected. The first sync did not finish; it will run again automatically.
outcome.failed: Google Calendar connection failed. Please try again.
outcome.scopeDenied: Calendar access was not granted, so nothing was connected.
outcome.notConfigured: Google Calendar is not configured on this server yet.

googleCalendar.notConfiguredTitle: Google Calendar is not set up yet
googleCalendar.notConfiguredMessage: An administrator must first add the Google OAuth settings to the server environment (see docs/GOOGLE_CALENDAR_SYNC.md §5). Missing:
